crossRefs.note: His wife the Jewess bore Jered the father of Gedor, Heber the father of Soco, and Jekuthiel the father of Zanoah. These…
Keilah, Achzib, and Mareshah; nine cities with their villages.
David was told, “Behold, the Philistines are fighting against Keilah, and are robbing the threshing floors.”

people.name: Eshtemoa
people.line: Levitical city in Judah; received spoils from David's victory

people.name: Hodiah
people.line: Wife of a Judahite named Ishbar.

people.name: Keilah
people.line: A town in the Shephelah of Judah, rescued by David

people.name: Naham
people.line: Brother of Hodiah who married Ishbar.

translations.web: The sons of the wife of Hodiah, the sister of Naham, were the father of Keilah the Garmite, and Eshtemoa the Maacathite.
translations.bsb: The sons of Hodiah’s wife, the sister of Naham, were the fathers of Keilah the Garmite and of Eshtemoa the Maacathite.
translations.kjv: And the sons of his wife Hodiah the sister of Naham, the father of Keilah the Garmite, and Eshtemoa the Maachathite.
translations.asv: And the sons of the wife of Hodiah, the sister of Naham, were the father of Keilah the Garmite, and Eshtemoa the Maacathite.
